unresolved_high_value_clusters.reason: 241 selectors excluded in this family. Many test 2D/3D texture copy validation; 78 selectors mention 3D. 10Level9 CopySubresourceRegion/CopyResource states only Texture2D and buffers are copyable within GPU memory, 3D-to-CPU copy is forbidden, and mipmapped volume copies are forbidden. This native restriction may justify some direct-copy exclusions, but does not resolve public wgpu coverage or fallback strategy; split by dimensions, usages, and CPU/GPU direction.

Validation selectors for format compatibility, attachment counts, and maxColorAttachmentBytesPerSample. FL9_1 has one RT; only six runtime byte-budget cases self-skip correctly because a five-target test fixture exceeds that cap. Remaining excluded selectors are potential avoidable validation-coverage gaps.

192 selectors are specifically under validation/image_copy/layout_related or texture_related. Additional buffer_related and buffer_texture_copies bring the full image_copy family to 241. Among all excluded selectors, 106 explicitly use dimension=2d (including 3 operation cases) and 78 use dimension=3d. Prioritize 2D buffer/texture layouts because 2D and buffers are explicitly copyable within GPU-accessible memory at FL9_1; split 3D according to native GPU copy/readback restrictions.
One runtime CTS skip says query nesting is unimplemented by CTS; native event query result/ordering and wgpu validation still need direct coverage.
